description: This grouped bar chart, which is visually presented at a tilted angle, illustrates the Ratio (%) achieved by three different models across three categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories; the first category label is cut off and not visible, while the second and third are labeled "Songs" and "Basketball," respectively. The vertical axis represents the "Ratio (%)" on a linear scale, displaying a range from 60 to 90 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The data is organized into grouped bars, with each category containing three side-by-side bars corresponding to the models identified in the top legend: Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. In the first, unlabeled category, Qwen2 has the highest value at approximately 94%, followed by Llama3 at roughly 92% and ChatGPT at about 79%. In the "Songs" category, Qwen2 reaches the tallest value in the chart at approximately 98%, with Llama3 at roughly 93% and ChatGPT recording the shortest overall bar at approximately 77%. For the "Basketball" category, Llama3 is the tallest at roughly 86%, followed by ChatGPT at about 83% and Qwen2 at approximately 78%. The categories and bars are not sorted in a strict ascending or descending order, and no specific bars are visually emphasized.
